reason: Ten articles individually classified: 1 conditional data-center load registry evidence hypothesis, nine no_opportunity; important separation of FERC approved large-load registry from rejected IRAS/BYONC provisions, and commercial-only Meta Muse model access.

articles.reason: FERC 9 October 2026 order substantially rejected PJM's proposed Interim Resource Adequacy Service and bring-your-own-new-capacity rules, citing retail-rate/state jurisdiction and discriminatory issues, but approved its proposed large-load definition and large-load registry covering facility location, ramp schedule, capacity supply, etc. It is not correct to claim the rejected curtailment scheme became binding. Data center applicant needs a transparent project-based readiness/evidence register under an evolving grid-connection rule set.
